funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Author Grants

amount.raw: Tiered: Small up to £2,000; Large from £2,001 to £6,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals at any stage of career; must be author or editor of the proposed publication, with publisher confirmed and publication date within three years of applying.
opportunities.summary: Financial support for individuals seeking to disseminate research on British art through publication of monographs, edited collections, catalogues and articles, covering costs such as image licensing, subventions, external contributor fees and translation.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Research Project Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any organisation, institution or nonprofit; collaborative applications welcomed. One Research Project Grant per organisation per round.
opportunities.summary: Flexible financial support for organisations undertaking ambitious and sustained research projects in the field of British art, primarily supporting staff costs towards facilitation of a research project with public-facing outcomes and/or legacy.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Exhibition Publication Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any organisation, institution or nonprofit producing publications related to their exhibitions and displays; exhibition may be forthcoming or already taken place.
opportunities.summary: Support for organisations to produce publications related to their exhibitions and displays, covering practical publishing costs such as image and production costs.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Event Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any organisation, institution or nonprofit; collaborative applications welcomed.
opportunities.summary: Support for organisations to disseminate research on British art through live, online and hybrid events intended for a variety of audiences, covering costs such as venue hire, accommodation for speakers and staffing.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Conservation Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any organisation, institution or nonprofit undertaking a conservation research project or technical analysis leading to a research project; items must be in public or charitable ownership and accessible to the public.
opportunities.summary: Funding to help protect and preserve significant works of British art by supporting organisations to undertake original and needed conservation research, covering staff and equipment costs.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Digitisation Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any organisation, institution or nonprofit undertaking work to digitise items and material in their own collections (e.g. photographic, archival, bound volumes, objects, paintings, publications).
opportunities.summary: Support for organisations seeking to make their collections freely available to audiences online via digitisation, covering personnel and equipment costs.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Emerging Researchers in British Art (ERBA) Research Travel Bursaries
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must be Members of Emerging Researchers in British Art (ERBA); membership pending is acceptable.
opportunities.summary: Micro-grants for ERBA Members to support a specific research trip (e.g. to a gallery, museum, collection, site, or to meet a key contact) covering travel, accommodation and reasonable expenses, to be used between November 2026 and April 2027.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Individual Research Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals at any career stage (up to £8,000); £8,001-£20,000 available to individuals at postdoctoral level or with equivalent research experience or above. Open to international applicants.
opportunities.summary: Flexible financial support for individuals to undertake research in British art, including research time (e.g. staff backfill, daily rates) and/or research travel to view collections or visit archives.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Study Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals enrolled to start (with a place confirmed) or already undertaking a master's level or doctoral level degree in British art, visual culture or architecture.
opportunities.summary: Financial support for individuals beginning or continuing a master's level or doctoral level degree who may face barriers in undertaking their course of study.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Andrew Wyld Research Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered students at undergraduate level and above, from any country.
opportunities.summary: Flexible financial support for registered students to undertake research trips to examine historical British works on paper (prints, drawings, watercolours) from the eighteenth and nineteenth centuries firsthand.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Master's Degree Scholarship

amount.raw: Total of £32,000 for one year, or split over two years if part time

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals who have applied for or are in receipt of an offer of a master's degree place at a UK-based institution, due to begin course between April 2027 and April 2028.
opportunities.summary: Full funding to support a master's degree (MA, MPhil, MSc or equivalent) in the field of British art, designed to bring new perspectives to our understanding of British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Doctoral Scholarship

amount.raw: Total of £96,000 awarded as £32,000 a year for three years, or split over further years

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals who have applied for or are in receipt of an offer of a doctorate degree at a UK-based institution, due to begin course between April 2027 and April 2028. International applicants welcome but amount fixed at £32,000/year.
opportunities.summary: Full funding to support doctoral research in the field of British art, paying university fees with the remainder supporting living expenses, plus an extra £500 per year for networking activities.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Early Career Fellowship

amount.raw: One year at total of £35,000, or two years at total of £70,000 (paid £35,000 per year)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals at postdoctoral level (or with equivalent experience) or above.
opportunities.summary: Financial support for individuals looking to undertake a major in-depth research project in the field of British art that will reshape our understanding of British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Rome Fellowship

amount.raw: Full board and accommodation at the British School at Rome for three months, plus an honorarium

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Scholars, researchers, curators, archivists and GLAM professionals with at least a first degree, from pre-doctoral PhD candidates to those internationally recognised in their field.
opportunities.summary: A three-month residency at the British School at Rome for individuals undertaking advanced research relating to cultural contact, exchange and influence between Britain and Italy.
